'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Michael Dalton DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Dalton]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
